neighbours.label: the first split piece ' gu', ' squ', ' gr' or ' qu' of an uncommon word (gu|inea, gu|ile, squ|all, gr|uel, qu|inine)
fire: The fine for the offense was one guinea in those days.
She won the argument by guile rather than force.
A sudden squall tore the sails off the little boat.
The prisoners were fed thin gruel twice a day.
Doctors gave the sailors quinine against the fever.
The clerk's fee was a guinea for each new deed.
The old fox used guile to reach the chicken coop.
The army sank deep into a quagmire near the river.
quiet: The fine for the offense was one dollar in those days.
She won the argument by reason rather than force.
A sudden storm tore the sails off the little boat.
The prisoners were fed thin soup twice a day.
Doctors gave the sailors water against the fever.
The clerk's fee was a shilling for each new deed.
The old fox used patience to reach the chicken coop.
The army sank deep into a swamp near the river.

short: first piece of uncommon gu-/squ-/qu- word
notes: Card: ' gu' x7, ' squ' x6, ' gr' x6, ' qu' x5, 'gu' x2, ' gro'. Probes: ' gu' in guinea 0.692 and guile 0.678, ' squ' 0.432, ' gro' 0.247; 'a dollar' 0.007. Tokens are checked. Near misses use common whole-token words in the same frames.
